title: Sausage and Pepper Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish made with sausage, peppers, onions, and tomatoes.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add the sliced peppers and onions.
Cook until the peppers and onions are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the sausage to the skillet and stir to combine with the peppers and onions.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
